thread.title: Intel falls as investors worry about costs of fixing chip bug

author: Reuters
title: Intel falls as investors worry about costs of fixing chip bug
text: (Reuters) - Intel Corp (INTC.O) shares fell nearly 3 percent on Thursday as investors worried that newly disclosed bugs in the company’s widely used computer microprocessors could be costly to mitigate. The largest maker of microprocessors confirmed on Wednesday that the vulnerabilities disclosed by a group of researchers affected computers, phones and other devices.
